body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Iotek(www.iotek.co.kr) introduced a 2.5-inch portable external hard drive 'Data Locker' with touchpad password entering system.
ㆍ Double-lock system: and patented by IOTEK.
ㆍ The HDD of ezSEUC: not readable even when connected to other devices.
ㆍ Easy TOUCHPAD password entering system.
ㆍ Does not require security software: convenient use at anytime and anywhere.
ㆍ One touch lock: press the lock button (icon) when you have to step out from your desk.
ㆍ Automatic shutdown: ezSECU shuts off automatically in case of attempt of password hacking.
